root_idea.summary: The root centers on turning or inclining toward something.
root_idea.development: The semantic field extends from physical or directional inclination to inward attachment, directed hearing, and lexicalized expressions involving a tilted vessel and reduced contents or due.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form صَغَا rather than the inflected QAC lemma صَغَتْ.

senses.definition: To incline toward something or be drawn toward it.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrences, the subject is the heart: hearts incline toward an object, influence, or matter. This Quranic sense concerns inward directional inclination; physical leaning and the specialized listening, celestial, and idiomatic uses are treated separately below.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lean or incline physically; to lean to one side or bend or bow over one's bow; also, to have an inclination of the jaw or one lip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or thing for bodily inclination; the jaw or lip application is an anatomical specialization.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline one's ear, give ear, hearken, or listen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A directed-hearing use, especially with an ear or hearing as the part inclined.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the stars or the sun, to incline toward setting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of celestial bodies approaching their setting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have one's love or affection attached to people outside the relevant party or group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A social or partisan use describing where a person's attachment lies.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Inclination; a disposition or alignment toward something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a verbal noun and also as a simple substantive.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression ابن صَغْوِكَ, a chosen or specially favored friend or companion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed or idiomatic expression for a special associate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The interior of a ladle; the side of a well; or the folded or turned-over part of the sides of a bucket.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun for an interior, side, or folded portion of a hollow implement or structure; its plural in these uses is أَصْغَاءٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline or turn a vessel onto its side so that its contents collect together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Takes a vessel as its object and describes deliberate tilting rather than simple inward inclination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To diminish, impair, or defraud someone of a portion of his right or due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the idiom أَصْغَى حَقَّهُ or with a thing whose proper portion is reduced.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To detract from a person's reputation, speak evil of him, or slander him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or tropical use associated with the expression أَصْغَى إِنَاءَهُ.
An idiomatic passive construction: أُصْغِيَ إِنَاءُ فُلَانٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline the head or ear toward someone; to give ear, hearken, or listen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may occur with the head or hearing as object, or alone with the meaning listen; it is also used of an animal inclining its head as if listening.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Those who incline toward a person and come to him seeking what he has; by extension, his family, guests, companions, or relations.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: صَاغِيَةٌ can function as a collective expression for a person's dependents or associates.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The stars that have inclined toward setting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural derived form used specifically of stars in their settingward inclination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having something inclined: of a person's jaw or lip, a bird's beak or mandible, or the sun as it inclines toward setting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use; صَغْوَاءُ is the feminine form and may intensify the description in the bird application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or direction toward which one inclines; figuratively, the person or destination to which one turns for benefit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of place or destination, including the proverbial sense of knowing where or to whom to turn.
A passive-participial or adjectival use without the vessel idiom.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having one's due or share reduced; being abridged or defrauded of one's right; by euphemism, doomed or perished.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression فُلَانٌ مُصْغًى إِنَاؤُهُ, the tilted-vessel image signifies deficiency in what one receives and may extend figuratively to destruction.
